caption: The drawing depicts three main objects. On the left is a vertically oriented, elongated object composed of a series of circular, semicircular, and straight-edged elements interconnected with strands of brownish ropes and adorned with hanging teardrop-shaped pendants. The object features alternating diamond and triangular patterns formed by the ropes, which are mainly brown and cream in color, with some black details. The pendants are shaded in brown and hang at regular intervals. In the upper center of the drawing, there is a small, isolated teardrop-shaped object with alternating blue and white horizontal stripes, set within a thin rectangular border. On the right side of the drawing, there is a circular object with a metallic appearance, shaded in gray, with an internal cross-like structure. Attached to this circle are long, vertical, cream-colored fringes and five diamond-shaped ornaments alternating in black and white, each holding a striped blue and white teardrop-shaped pendant, visually matching the isolated object above. At the bottom right, the name “Mabel G. Claflin, Taos, N.M.” is written in small, red text. The drawing is set on a plain, off-white background.
title: Spanish Cinch
